findings.body: The allowed scope is limited to the six implementation and test paths, but this branch still rewrites the story task decomposition and read record and changes `.factory/stories/ASK-MULTI-PLANT/story.json` plus its task record. The handoff names no necessary out-of-scope changes, and none of these files is needed to deliver or test the plant-rules module. Remove these independently changed planning and Factory files from this patch.
findings.title: Remove the unrelated out-of-scope planning and Factory changes

findings.body: The coordinator ruled that picker choices and `allPlants.value` should use the same deterministic canonical-code order, but the options use locale-dependent `localeCompare` while this line re-sorts their values using JavaScript's UTF-16 default comparator. These comparators are not equivalent, particularly with current mixed-case canonical codes such as `NLR` and `Nandyal`, so the visible option order can diverge from the submitted All-plants order and vary by host locale. This differing pair of comparators is new evidence not addressed by the ruling; reuse the already sorted option order or the same explicit comparator for both.
findings.title: Keep picker options and All plants in the same canonical order
